title: KW Semigroups -- Their Betti Numbers, Apéry Posets and Tangent Cones
summary: Let p , where 2r=p,q,p+q whichever is even. In this paper, we prove a conjecture on the Betti numbers of the semigroup rings of these semigroups, showing that they coincide with those of the ideal of 2x2 minors of a 2xn generic matrix, where n is the embedding dimension. Moreover, we characterize the Apéry posets of Kunz-Waldi semigroups and determine when their tangent cones are Cohen-Macaulay.
